items.html: What you'll learn

It's not just about AI and automation. We also cover:

  • How to manage your clients in one system

  • How to set up a working sales pipeline

  • How to track your proposals and offers

Pipedrive provides its own AI features and automation module, and connects directly with Make.com and n8n integrations.
WHO IT'S FOR
Is this for you?

Business owners, sales managers, real estate agents, insurance advisors, consultants...

If you've outgrown spreadsheets, want to introduce AI and automation into your workflow, or simply want to run your sales process in a more structured way, this workshop is built for you.
Lead generation

Every lead lands in one system. No more lost emails, no more spreadsheets. Leads from your website, social media, and Google come in automatically, so you always have a full picture of your pipeline. Your existing customers are your easiest source of new revenue, so you can see who's been neglected and plan your outreach accordingly.

items.alt: Pipedrive Pulse feature showing automated lead actions and reminders

items.html: Conversion & execution

You move every deal through a structured process, so the next step is always clear. Tasks and to-dos stay in the system, not in your head. Automation handles the routine admin work, so you spend more time selling and less time chasing.

items.alt: Pipedrive pipeline view showing structured deal stages and next steps

items.html: Visibility & control

Review your analytics and use AI features to spot new sales opportunities. Get automatic notifications and reminders so deals and projects keep moving. Sales forecasts update automatically as your pipeline progresses.

items.alt: Pipedrive sales forecast chart showing monthly revenue growth

Frequently asked questions (FAQ)

Is Pipedrive difficult to set up?

No. Pipedrive was designed for salespeople, not IT teams, so it's fast to set up and easy to navigate from day one.

The system has more than 100,000 users worldwide, and over 70,000 companies started using it without any outside help. Plenty of video content is available, we offer a free workshop to get you started, and full implementation services are available if you want to move faster or scale with a larger team.

How long does it take to learn?

The first few days will slow you down slightly as you get familiar with the system. After that, it speeds everything up significantly.

The logic stays the same: what you learn on day one is still exactly where you left it a week, a month, or six months later. The goal of the workshop is to help you understand the full system and feel confident from the start.

I work alone. Is this relevant for me?

Yes. A structured system matters regardless of company size.

As a solo operator or small team, it's even more important to have a clear view of your clients, your proposals, and your next steps. Pipedrive is used the same way by individual freelancers and by sales teams of several hundred people.

Is there a mobile app?

Yes. Pipedrive's mobile app gives you full functionality, not a stripped-down version. You can log calls, check your pipeline, and review reports on the go.

How much does the software cost?

Pipedrive offers monthly and annual plans. See the pricing page for the available plans.

Will my team actually use it?

Yes. Pipedrive was built for salespeople, so it's fast, visual, and straightforward to use every day.

The simpler a system is, the more data goes into it, because people actually use it. One of the most common pieces of feedback we hear from clients: "Finally, a CRM they don't hate."
